title: media-api upload failure ratio above objective
body: Alert media-upload-failures fired at 04:30:22Z. POST /v1/media failing at 0.48 of attempts against an objective of 0.01. Alert cleared at 05:18:40Z.

title: nightly-backup job duration above objective
body: Alert backup-duration fired at 04:31:05Z. The nightly backup for the reporting database took 96 minutes against an objective of 60. This job runs on the reporting cluster and shares no capacity with media-api.

title: certificate expiring within 30 days
body: Alert certificate-expiry-warning fired at 04:33:41Z for cdn-edge.example.com, which expires in 27 days. This is a scheduled advisory alert unrelated to any request path.

title: analytics-ingest consumer lag warning
body: Alert analytics-lag fired at 04:40:12Z. The analytics ingest consumer is 12000 messages behind. This consumer reads a topic media-api does not produce to.

title: media-api node volume full
body: media-api node media-3: writes to /var/lib/media-staging failing with ENOSPC beginning 04:29:47Z. The volume is 100% used. Uploads are staged to this volume before transfer to object storage.

title: upload requests return 500
body: media-api: POST /v1/media returning 500 staging_write_failed. Every failing request was routed to node media-3.

title: staging volume usage series
body: Series media_staging_volume_used_ratio on media-3 rose steadily from 0.61 to 1.00 between 2026-03-10 and 2026-03-17. No alert is configured on this series at any threshold.

title: staging volume reclaimed
body: media-api node media-3: an operator deleted 412GB of orphaned staging files at 05:18:22Z. Volume usage fell to 0.34 and uploads succeeded again by 05:18:40Z.

title: media-api release 12.4.0
body: Release 12.4.0 deployed at 18:20:00Z on 2026-03-16, ten hours before the incident. Changes: adds an image format to the accepted list.

title: responder overwhelmed by alert volume
body: Responder N: 'We have four alerts firing. Backup duration, a cert warning, analytics lag, and the upload failures. Are these related? Do we have a platform-wide problem?'

title: responder separates the alerts
body: Responder O: 'Only the upload alert is ours. Backup runs on the reporting cluster, the cert warning is a 27-day advisory, and analytics reads a topic we do not produce to. Every failing upload is on media-3, whose staging volume is full.'

title: responder raises monitoring gap
body: Responder O: 'The volume filled over a week and nothing alerted. Nobody has checked whether the other media nodes are close to full, or why orphaned staging files are never cleaned up.'

title: INC-4408 opened
body: INC-4408 opened at 04:36:00Z, severity 2, title 'Media uploads failing'. The ticket records no count of failed uploads and none was added before resolution.
